hangdangaw preliminary note the name hangdangaw is the contracted form of hangka one time and dangaw span or the distance from the tip of the thumb to the tip of the middle finger
according to mullung the narrator it was given because of this boy midget size
there is no description of hangdangaw size all throughout the story
in fact his name is mentioned only later in the text no
to contrast his height with the giant agasi
right at the beginning of the story there also seems to be some confusion when the narrator says that hangdangaw grew up the only explanation suggested so far is that the narrator extrapolated from the normal child growth and possibly meant the growth in age
when asked about this the narrator said the story was that way the hangdangaw narrative of mullung is closely related to host of similar folktales found all over the philippines from cagayan valley in northern luzon to sulu
several versions or variants are mentioned fansler
they are pusong in visayan cabagboc in bicol sandapal in tagalog sandangcal and greedy juan in pampangan juan tapon and pangandangan in ilocano and tangarangan in ibanag the whole batangas version the story of carancal is given in english
fansler continues up to the point when the hero leaves home these various stories agree in the main the hero is dwarf of superhuman strength and extraordinary eating capacity his parents are driven poverty to attempt to kill him but their efforts are in vain he finally determines to leave home often taking with him some mighty weapon
from this point on the narratives differ widely
all are alike in this respect however the hero never marries
all that is except our tausug version where hangdangaw happily marries the sultan sister
in the pages that follow the hangdangaw narrative is presented in three versions tausug literal translation and free translation
the first two versions have been set in paralleltext form and the free translation all revised from rixhon follows immediately after them
notes and references are found at the end of the entire article
